queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network configuration" OR NetOps "intent to configuration" "configuration generation"
queries.rationale: Locate work where LLMs are used to translate operator intent or natural language into network configurations or change plans (core phenomenon).

queries.query: "configuration repair" OR "configuration synthesis" "LLM" OR "large language model" "network"
queries.rationale: Find literature on using generative models to repair or synthesize correct configurations from faulty inputs or policy violations (mechanisms and failure modes).
Search for architectures combining generation, verification, and iterative repair for NetOps tasks (mitigations / guarded workflows).

queries.query: Batfish OR "header space analysis" OR "formal verification" "network configuration" verification reachability policy
queries.rationale: Collect formal and deterministic verification tools and methods used to check network configurations (benchmarking validity and validators).

queries.query: NetOps benchmark OR "AIOps benchmark" "network configuration dataset" "6G-Bench" "TSNBench" "OpsEval"
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmark suites, datasets, and evaluation protocols used for NetOps and AIOps to assess coverage and limitations (benchmark validity).
Find analyses of hallucination or incorrect factual generation in contexts relevant to operational network tasks (phenomenon and risks).

queries.query: "prompt injection" OR "adversarial prompt" "LLM" "network configuration" OR NetOps
queries.rationale: Search for adversarial and security-related mechanisms that could cause LLMs to produce unsafe or malicious NetOps outputs (threat models).
Locate methods where LLMs call external tools (verifiers, simulators) for correctness checks and iterative correction (mitigations & design patterns).

queries.query: "evaluation metrics" "network configuration" "functional correctness" "intent satisfaction" reachability equivalence
queries.rationale: Gather proposed metrics and evaluation methods for judging whether generated configurations meet operator intent and preserve network properties (methods & validity).
Find simulation/emulation platforms and experimental setups used to execute and validate configuration changes (methods and reproducible evaluation).

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" "LLM" "NetOps" OR "network operations" operator trust explanation usability
queries.rationale: Explore human factors, operator trust, and explainability when LLMs propose or apply network changes (neighbouring work / mitigations).
Survey agentic orchestration frameworks and multi-tool agent designs applied or adaptable to NetOps tasks (mechanisms, tool stacks, safety patterns).

queries.query: "program synthesis" OR "program repair" "code LLM" "transformer" "software configuration repair"
queries.rationale: Identify transferable techniques from program synthesis/repair and code LLMs that could inform NetOps configuration generation and automated repair (neighbouring fields).

queries.query: "network configuration dataset" public configs "CAIDA" "CISCO configs" "topology dataset"
queries.rationale: Locate public datasets of real or synthetic network configs and topologies for realistic evaluation and external validity checks (data sources / reproducibility).

Search for work on generalization and transferability issues when models trained or tested in synthetic environments are applied to real-world network operations (benchmark validity / external threats).

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal publications, or openly archived preprints (arXiv) with verifiable metadata.
Publicly available code, datasets, or tool releases tied to publications when present (for reproducibility).
Works that address LLMs/generative models applied to network configuration, validation, repair, or NetOps workflows, or that propose verification/simulation tools relevant to NetOps.
Papers proposing evaluation metrics, benchmarks, or experimental methods for NetOps/AIOps and studies of LLM failure modes/mitigations in operational contexts.
Relevant neighbouring-field research (program synthesis/repair, software configuration management, explainability, human factors, security) with clear transfer potential to NetOps.
exclusion_criteria: Press releases, marketing/blog posts, or vendor white papers lacking verifiable bibliographic metadata, unless they are the primary source for a released tool (in which case reference the tool repo).
Works unrelated to network operations or configuration management (pure NLP theory with no operational transfer argument).
Unverifiable or private/non-public datasets, proprietary corpora, or pre-lock development artifacts not publicly archived.
Duplicates or derivative summaries without primary-source contribution.
date_rationale: Cover foundational verification and network-configuration literature (no strict lower bound) but prioritize rapid LLM-era developments: focus on 2018–2026 with particular emphasis on 2021–2026 when LLMs and tool-augmented agent designs accelerated. This window balances historical methods (formal verification, Batfish) with the latest generative-AI AIOps work and benchmarks.
